title: Tints
slide_intent: Show how lighter values can support sustained reading and distinguish data without introducing another hue family.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can adapt its assertive core palette to charts, reports and informational callouts while keeping a recognizable color relationship.
demonstration: Four swatch columns step down from the core colors to lighter tints. Ring charts and a text panel show applications beneath them.
practical_value: Use related tints for a chart with few data points or the background behind a small text callout. Check that distinctions remain readable.

content_islands.name: Tint ladder
content_islands.spec: Head four adjacent columns with the solid green, pink, blue and black swatches and stack lighter percentage bands beneath.

content_islands.name: Chart comparison
content_islands.spec: Group ring charts and their color keys in the lower left. Attach the pink caution to the example that mixes tints inappropriately.

content_islands.name: Report detail
content_islands.spec: Place the excerpt with a tinted text panel beside the charts and point a note toward the background behind the small type.
